005package org.wpilib.driverstation;
006
007import java.util.concurrent.locks.Lock;
008import java.util.concurrent.locks.ReentrantLock;
009import org.wpilib.datalog.DataLog;
010import org.wpilib.driverstation.internal.DriverStationBackend;
011
012/** Provides access to Driver Station functionality. */
013public final class DriverStation {
014  private DriverStation() {}
015
016  private static final Lock m_dsLock = new ReentrantLock();
017  private static final GenericHID[] m_hids = new GenericHID[DriverStationBackend.JOYSTICK_PORTS];
018  private static final Gamepad[] m_gamepads = new Gamepad[DriverStationBackend.JOYSTICK_PORTS];
019
020  private static GenericHID getGenericHIDUnderLock(int port) {
021    GenericHID toRet = m_hids[port];
022    if (toRet == null) {
023      toRet = new GenericHID(port);
024      m_hids[port] = toRet;
025    }
026    return toRet;
027  }
028
029  /**
030   * Gets the GenericHID object for the given port. GenericHID objects are cached, so this will
031   * always return the same object for the same port.
032   *
033   * @param port The port index on the Driver Station that the controller is plugged into (0-5).
034   * @return The GenericHID object for the given port.
035   */
036  public static GenericHID getGenericHID(int port) {
037    m_dsLock.lock();
038    try {
039      return getGenericHIDUnderLock(port);
040    } finally {
041      m_dsLock.unlock();
042    }
043  }
044
045  /**
046   * Gets the Gamepad object for the given port. Gamepad objects are cached, so this will always
047   * return the same object for the same port.
048   *
049   * @param port The port index on the Driver Station that the controller is plugged into (0-5).
050   * @return The Gamepad object for the given port.
051   */
052  public static Gamepad getGamepad(int port) {
053    m_dsLock.lock();
054    try {
055      Gamepad toRet = m_gamepads[port];
056      if (toRet == null) {
057        toRet = new Gamepad(getGenericHIDUnderLock(port));
058        m_gamepads[port] = toRet;
059      }
060      return toRet;
061    } finally {
062      m_dsLock.unlock();
063    }
064  }
065
066  /**
067   * Starts logging DriverStation data to data log, including joystick data. Repeated calls are
068   * ignored.
069   *
070   * @param log data log
071   */
072  public static void startDataLog(DataLog log) {
073    DriverStationBackend.startDataLog(log);
074  }
075
076  /**
077   * Starts logging DriverStation data to data log. Repeated calls are ignored.
078   *
079   * @param log data log
080   * @param logJoysticks if true, log joystick data
081   */
082  public static void startDataLog(DataLog log, boolean logJoysticks) {
083    DriverStationBackend.startDataLog(log, logJoysticks);
084  }
085
086  /**
087   * Registers the given handle for DS data refresh notifications.
088   *
089   * @param handle The event handle.
090   */
091  public static void provideRefreshedDataEventHandle(int handle) {
092    DriverStationBackend.provideRefreshedDataEventHandle(handle);
093  }
094
095  /**
096   * Unregisters the given handle from DS data refresh notifications.
097   *
098   * @param handle The event handle.
099   */
100  public static void removeRefreshedDataEventHandle(int handle) {
101    DriverStationBackend.removeRefreshedDataEventHandle(handle);
102  }
103}
